chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Chick Webb the arrangement drummer versus New Orleans drumming
summary: Zutty calls Chick Webb a big-time arrangement drummer, an early band drummer respected by Duke; Zutty always played for the soloist, the New Orleans way, a difference audible on Webb's records.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
